state:
From: procurement.ops@example.com
To: vendor.data@example.com
Subject: RE: RE: possible duplicate suppliers - Delta Fasteners

Hi team,

Following up on the duplicate report from last week. We have two supplier records that look related:

Record S-1182: Delta Fasteners Inc., 400 Foundry Road, Unit 7, Carver City. Contact: Hal Osei, hal.osei@example.com, 555-0115. Categories: bolts, anchors, threaded rod. Bank account ending 7720. Created 2016 by the Carver plant.

Record S-2045: Delta Fastener Supply Co., 400 Foundry Rd, Carver City. Contact: purchasing desk, orders.delta@example.com, 555-0115. Categories: bolts, washers, rivets, safety wire. Bank account ending 1954. Created 2022 by the Linden plant.

What we know: Hal confirmed by phone that 'Delta Fastener Supply' is their distribution arm and invoices separately, but he wasn't sure whether it is a separate company or just a division. The shared phone number is their main switchboard. The Linden plant says they have never had a quality issue with S-2045; the Carver plant flagged S-1182 twice last year for late deliveries (unrelated to this question, just context for the review).

Legal asked us not to merge records with different bank accounts unless we have a W-9 or equivalent tax form showing the same tax ID for both. We only have a W-9 on file for S-1182. Finance mentioned that the 2022 onboarding packet for S-2045 might be in the shared drive, but nobody has checked.

Can someone make the call? The quarterly spend report double counts Delta if these are the same supplier.

Thanks,
Priya

---
